title: magnen77's Enchantments
description: This datapack adds 10 new enchantments for PvP (3 for the crossbow, 3 for the trident, 1 for the chestplate, 2 for the axe, and 1 for the sword) and introduces some changes.
body:
This datapack adds 10 new enchantments for PvP (3 for the crossbow, 3 for the trident, 1 for the chestplate, 2 for the axe, and 1 for the sword) and introduces some changes.

## ⚡Some changes
- **Sharpness** can now be **applied** to the **trident**.

## ✨New Enchantments
### Fast Blade
Enchantment for **SWORD**, max level: 3, increases attack speed by 8%/14%/20% depending on the level.
Can be found in "Ruins of Bygone Times" in suspicious gravel.

### Rampage
Enchantment for **AXE**, max level: 3, increases movement speed by 8%/16%/24% depending on the level.
Can be found in the "Desert Pyramid" in the room with suspicious sand.

### Breeze
Enchantment for **CROSSBOW**, max level: 2, creates a vortex cloud similar to the "Wind Burst" enchantment on the mace, upon hitting an entity or a block.
Can be found in the vault in the "Trial Chambers".

### Sniper Rifle
Enchantment for **CROSSBOW**, max level: 1, enhances arrows fired from the crossbow while holding SHIFT.
Can be found in a chest in the "Pillager Outpost".

### Marker
Enchantment for **CROSSBOW**, max level: 1, places a mark on the target, highlighting it and reducing its defense.
Can be found in a chest in the "Pillager Outpost".

### Forge Heart
Enchantment for **CHESTPLATE**, max level: 1, when hit, there is a 50% chance that the attacker catches fire, and you also burn any cobweb you are standing in.
Can be found in the treasure chest in the "Bastion".

### Leviathan Breath
Enchantment for **TRIDENT**, max level: 1, upon hitting with the trident, applies Slowness III–IV to the target for 5–7 seconds.
Has a small chance to drop from the Elder Guardian.

### Dark Hand
Enchantment for **TRIDENT**, max level: 1, upon hitting with the trident, applies Darkness I to the target for 4–6 seconds.
Has a small chance to drop from the Warden.

### Vampirism
Enchantment for **TRIDENT**, max level: 1, upon hitting with the trident, has a 75% chance to give you Regeneration II for 2–3 seconds.
Can be found in a chest in the "Monster Spawner" or in the "Abandoned Mineshaft" in the Dark Forest.

### Retribution
Enchantment for **AXE**, max level: 1, upon hitting, marks are placed on the target (from one to four). Five seconds after the last axe hit, the target takes 0/8/16/24 damage depending on the number of marks.
Can be found in the treasure chest in the "Mansion".

## ⚙️Additional information
The datapack includes Russian (ru_ru) and English (en_us) localizations.
